purpose: Research following the user's rejection of the mannequin morph and pose studies; no further asset or frontend rebuild in this research pass.

reference.implementation: Explicit combo-to-image lookup; imageFront/imageBack assets, paired preloading and synchronized image crossfade.
reference.visualReview: Browser verified a realistic body with visible baseline breast descent/abdominal volume, identical pose across the two reviewed states, and dashed selection contours on augmentation.
reference.unknown: The original authoring application and production method are not verifiable from the website.

observed.priorValidationLimit: Finite vertex positions, normalized weights and edge-length checks did not establish anatomical quality or visual acceptance.

recommendation.status: Proposed, not a new user approval or a completed implementation.
recommendation.presentation: Author in 3D, deliver controlled full-state images in the webpage, initially fixed front/back views.
recommendation.anatomy: Use a master body with a meaningful baseline and anatomically sculpted target shapes. Do not reuse the rejected Gaussian deformations as final anatomy.
recommendation.authoring: Manual character/anatomy sculpting, stable topology for morphs, pose-specific corrective shapes if additional poses are retained.
recommendation.production: Lock pose, camera, lighting, materials and crop. Review silhouettes before surface detail. Render complete states rather than blend horizontal photographic bands.

optionalTools.name: Character Creator 5
optionalTools.role: Candidate production human base, body morphs, Blender/ZBrush sculpt round-trip; still requires sculpted procedure-specific targets.

optionalTools.name: Daz Genesis 9
optionalTools.role: Alternative render-oriented human base; official Blender bridge exists. Compatibility with local Blender5.2 not validated.

optionalTools.name: Auto-Rig Pro
optionalTools.role: Rigging/corrective-driver workflow if poses remain in scope; not a substitute for sculpting the target shape.

scopeCalculation.rule: Three body options; zero or one of three breast options; maximum three selections

recommendation.firstQualitySample: One finished master plus augmentation/reduction/lift in fixed front/profile views, before expanding to all combinations.
recommendation.acceptance: The viewer can distinguish each target quickly at actual mobile size; believable shoulder/waist/breast/hip surfaces; consistent crop and lighting; distinguish breast elevation from volume change; inspect combined states visually.
